scenario: [LTIM.14.3]: the compiler refuses a `const` whose fold would raise [LTIM.14.2]'s fault, with DS_VALIDATE_CONST_NOT_FOLDABLE: `const BAD = calendar.date(2026, 2, 30)` names no day, so the call has no value to fold to. The rest of the program is valid, so the refusal is the `const`'s. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate`'s `ltim_14_3_raising_calls` over the `const`'s expression, through `dsc.dstest.ltim_14_3_calendar_fold`, which folds the call with `ds.chrono.ltim_14_2_date`, the function the engine evaluates it with.
